observation: The documented tool extends a curve from its tip and resamples the existing control points along the new shape. It does not promise to bend the entire original length into the desired route.
productionDecision: Reject a long normal-grown initial spike if it survives tip dragging. A corrected tool-use trial must start from short native roots and extend through region-specific artist gestures; independently inspect saved paths and full finite contacts. No radius/strength/count sweep or dense expansion to hide the wrong basis.
